title: build(deps): bump @supabase/supabase-js from 2.115.0 to 2.116.0
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. @supabase/supabase-js 2.115.0 -> 2.116.0 in packages/client, which moves the whole @supabase family in lockstep. Minor release: four additive features (auth MFA recovery codes API; storage bucket lifecycle configuration, top-k 10k, versionId on create-URL methods) and three fixes (auth: silence a commit-guard-discarded refresh in the initial session; storage: drop a legacy lifecycle prefix; supabase: warn when `schema` is passed outside `db` options). No repository code adopts any new API. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001); the payload of that friction is the lockfile audit in behavior_change.
behavior_change: No declared-dependency movement beyond the titled family; one small runtime effect on the live auth path, stated rather than hidden. Lockfile audited against merge base 7685411c by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry in full, not by reading the diff view. Entry count is 412 before and 412 after. Exactly six node_modules entries changed, all the @supabase family moving 2.115.0 -> 2.116.0 in lockstep: auth-js, functions-js, postgrest-js, realtime-js, storage-js, supabase-js -- each changing only version, resolved and integrity, except supabase-js, whose `dependencies` map also changed. That map was checked key by key because a family bump is exactly where PR #296 hid an unrelated revert: its only movements are the five sibling pins 2.115.0 -> 2.116.0, and it gained no new dependency. Zero packages added, zero removed, zero non-@supabase entries touched. The root entry differs in one key, dependencies.@supabase/supabase-js ^2.115.0 -> ^2.116.0. Runtime: the sole importer, src/auth/supabase.ts, IS reachable from src/main.ts, so this bump does reach users. It calls createClient with only auth {autoRefreshToken, persistSession, detectSessionInUrl} and supabase.auth.getSession(); it passes no `schema` option, so the new 2.116.0 warning cannot fire. The auth fix touches the initial-session refresh path those flags use: it silences a discarded refresh rather than changing session semantics.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves the single declared range for @supabase/supabase-js from ^2.115.0 to ^2.116.0 -- one line, no other dependency touched. package-lock.json resolves the family: auth-js, functions-js, postgrest-js, realtime-js, storage-js and supabase-js 2.115.0 -> 2.116.0, plus supabase-js's own sibling pins. No incidental version movement outside the family; the added, removed and non-@supabase changed sets are all empty.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency, stated plainly. No existing manifest covers this diff; the prior family manifest (supabase-js-2.115.0-bump) and other dependency manifests would each cover these two files, and borrowing one is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 refuses.
